ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants to Company that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each of the Works and deliverables provided under a Statement of Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation, and that the Works will not contain any virus, malicious or disabling code. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, Works or deliverables, or a refund of the fees paid for them.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a 90-day conformity warranty for deliverables plus a repair/replace/refund remedy, since the current Section 5 contains no performance warranty or remedy for non-conforming Works. This matches our playbook fallback position (90 days for deliverables) and leaves the existing workmanlike standard in Section 1(b) intact.
input.summary: Insert 90-day deliverable conformity warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy into Section 5.
